definitions.explanation: A rice dish made by cooking rice in seasoned broth with various ingredients. Often made with leftover rice and served as comfort food or to finish a hot pot meal.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}の{後|あと}に{雑炊|ぞうすい}を{作|つく}りました。
examples.english: I made zosui after the hot pot meal.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}いたときは{雑炊|ぞうすい}が{食|た}べやすいです。
examples.english: Zosui is easy to eat when you have a cold.

examples.japanese: {卵|たまご}を{入|い}れた{雑炊|ぞうすい}は{美味|おい}しいです。
{残|のこ}ったご{飯|はん}で{雑炊|ぞうすい}を{作|つく}ると、{簡単|かんたん}に{一品|いっぴん}できます。
examples.english: You can easily make a dish by using leftover rice to make zosui.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}の{後|あと}の{出汁|だし}がよく{出|で}たスープで{作|つく}る{雑炊|ぞうすい}は、{締|し}めにぴったりの{一品|いっぴん}です。
examples.english: Zosui made with the richly flavored broth left after a hot pot is the perfect finishing dish.
examples.notes: {締|し}め refers to the final dish to finish a meal

notes:
{雑炊|ぞうすい} is a Japanese rice porridge made by simmering rice in seasoned broth.

Characteristics:
- Made with cooked rice (unlike {粥|かゆ}/okayu which starts with raw rice)
- Uses flavorful broth (dashi, hot pot liquid)
- Rice retains some texture
- Often has egg swirled in at the end

Common occasions:
- After {鍋料理|なべりょうり} (hot pot) - uses the flavorful remaining broth
- When sick - easy to digest comfort food
- Late-night meal

Common additions:
- {卵|たまご} (egg)
- {葱|ねぎ} (green onion)
- {海苔|のり} (seaweed)

Related:
- {粥|かゆ} / お{粥|かゆ} - rice porridge made from raw rice
